title: 第5章 八阶天空剑师
slug: 魔兽剑圣异界纵横全本免费-魔兽剑圣异界纵横最新章节列表
content_zh:
一个星期之后，四大帝国的队伍终于抵达“冒险小镇”。
再经过一天的整顿，浩浩荡荡的大队人马朝“死亡森林”开拔而进。
刘枫现在跟着的是苏菲所在的佣兵队伍，是佣兵工会极少的内部直属部队之一。
看着一步三岗的警戒人员，差不多个个都在四阶之上，这让刘枫对外界所传闻的佣兵工会没有属于自己的队伍的传言，产生了很大的怀疑。
想想也对，存在了这么多年的古老工会，实力怎么可能会弱到哪里去，可能外间传言，是佣兵工会放出的烟雾弹吧。
跟在苏菲身边，刘枫见到了这只队伍的带头之人，一位身穿红色宽大的剑师袍的老者。
苏菲带着刘枫向老者走去，轻声的道：“他是我们佣兵工会的元老之一，是我父亲的好友，八阶天空剑师，霍塔，从小对我很好的，你等会可尽量不要惹他生气哦。”
刘枫轻轻点头，示意明白。
霍塔早已远远看见苏菲的身影，大步迎了上来，笑道：“小菲儿，让我来看看祢，一年不见，又漂亮了许多啊。”
苏菲轻轻一笑，上前拉住霍塔的手臂，撒娇道：“霍叔，我也很想你呢。”
“哈哈”霍塔欣慰的笑了起来，眼睛一抬，看着正立在一旁的刘枫，有些疑惑的问道：“小菲儿，这位是？”
“霍叔，他是我。。。朋友。”苏菲俏色一红，有些吞吐的介绍道。
已是人老成精的霍塔见到苏菲那少女含春模样，心中哪还不明白，细细的看向刘枫，见之一副弱不惊风的模样，不由眉头一皱。
在旁边一直看着他表情的苏菲，见状，心中一急，这霍叔可是父亲的至友，若他不满意的话，父亲那里多半就也不好过了，忙伸过头在霍塔耳边娇声道：“霍叔，你可别小看刘枫，我用了家族密功”残解“都打不过他呢！”
霍塔闻言一惊，随既急道：“你用了“残解”？你这孩子难道不知道那功法最伤人吗？”
苏菲甜甜一笑：“没事，霍叔，我还没运转大法，就被刘枫阻止下了。”
霍塔这才松了一口气，口气却依旧严厉：“以后不到生死关头，不准再用那鬼“残解”了，知道吗？”
苏菲乖乖的点了点头。
霍塔再次看向刘枫，这次眼里似乎变得柔和了许多，伸出粗大的右手，对刘枫豪迈道：“来，小子，让我来看看，你有多强的实力，配不配得上我家菲儿。”
刘枫剑眉一扬，毫不畏惧的伸出右手，握了上去，一大一小，一黄一白的俩只手掌形成了怪异的情形。

霍塔浑身气势猛的大涨，体内斗气狂涌，运聚右手之上，泛着浓烈的红色光芒。
感受到手上的压力剧增，刘枫丹田之中，银河气旋猛的加快的旋转速度，一股股强大的真气，沿着经脉抵达手心，抵御着那庞大的压力。
双方僵持不下。
霍塔气势再次猛涨，脸色潮红，明显已是用上了全力。
刘枫也是一脸凝重，右手之上俯上了薄薄的一层白色气芒，丹田之中的气旋已经在以超越极限的速度运转，扯得丹田一阵阵抽痛。
俩人周围的草地上已被狂暴的气势刮去了厚厚的一层草皮，苏菲也是退到了十几步外，不安的看着场中的俩人。
“老二，你在干什么。”一声暴喝声传来，打断了俩人的对恃。
俩人收功，各自急退了三步，化去了冲力。
苏菲连忙跑过来，拉着刘枫不断察看，害怕受到一点伤害。
“丫头，放心吧，你那小情郎好得很，我可没伤到他半点。”霍塔见到苏菲一脸的急相，不由取笑道。
闹了一个大红脸的苏菲，娇嗔道：“霍叔，你。。。”
身后的刘枫伸手拉过苏菲，对霍塔抱拳笑道：“霍叔，斗气真是强横，小子差点就支持不住了。”
“哈哈，不错，你小子还是很不错，菲儿眼光很好。”霍塔大笑道，显然对刘枫很是满意。
“你这老家伙，没看见是菲儿带来的朋友吗？尽然还用上了全力，真是没用。”一位身着红色魔法袍的老人，从不远处的帐篷里走了出来，边走边道。
“这也是我父亲的好朋友，霍暴，八阶大魔导师，也是霍塔叔叔的哥哥，从小就对我很好的。”苏菲替刘枫轻声解说道。

content_en:
A week later, the teams of the four empires finally arrived at the "Adventure Town".
After another day of reorganizing, the mighty team marched towards the "Forest of Death".
Liu Feng is currently following Sophie's mercenary team, which is one of the few internal units directly under the mercenary union.
Looking at the security personnel at one step and three posts, almost all of them were above the fourth level, which made Liu Feng very suspicious of the rumors that the mercenary union did not have its own team.
It's right to think about it. How could the strength of the ancient union that has existed for so many years be so weak? Maybe there are rumors that it is a smoke bomb released by the mercenary union.
Following Sophie, Liu Feng saw the leader of this team, an old man wearing a red and loose sword master's robe.
Sophie led Liu Feng towards the old man and said softly: "He is one of the elders of our mercenary union. He is my father's friend, the eighth-level Sky Swordsman, Huo Ta. He has been very good to me since I was a child. Please try not to make him angry later."
Liu Feng nodded slightly, indicating that he understood.
Horta had already seen Sophie's figure from a distance, strode up to meet her, and said with a smile: "Xiao Fei'er, let me come and see you. I haven't seen you for a year, and you are much more beautiful again."
Sophie smiled softly, stepped forward and took Huo Ta's arm, and said coquettishly: "Uncle Huo, I miss you too."
"Haha" Huo Ta laughed happily, raised his eyes, looked at Liu Feng who was standing aside, and asked with some confusion: "Xiao Fei'er, who is this?"
"Uncle Huo, he is my... friend." Sophie blushed and introduced hesitantly.
The already mature Huo Ta didn't understand what was happening when he saw Sophie's youthful appearance. He looked at Liu Feng carefully and frowned when he saw a weak and unfazed look.
Sophie, who had been watching his expression from the side, felt anxious when she saw this. This Uncle Huo is his father's best friend. If he is not satisfied, his father will probably have a hard time. She hurriedly stretched her head and whispered in Huo Ta's ear: "Uncle Huo, don't underestimate Liu Feng. I can't beat him even with my family's secret technique "Zanjie"!"
Huo Ta was shocked when he heard this, and then said hurriedly: "Did you use "Remnant Solution"? Don't you kid know that the most hurtful technique?"
Sophie smiled sweetly: "It's okay, Uncle Huo, Liu Feng stopped me before I could use the magic."
Hota breathed a sigh of relief, but his tone was still stern: "In the future, you are not allowed to use that ghost to "disable" it until the critical moment of life and death, do you understand?"
Sophie nodded obediently.
Huo Ta looked at Liu Feng again, and this time his eyes seemed to be much softer. He stretched out his thick right hand and said boldly to Liu Feng: "Come on, boy, let me see how strong you are and whether you are worthy of my Fei'er."
Liu Feng raised his sword eyebrows, stretched out his right hand without fear, and held it. His two palms, one large and one small, one yellow and one white, formed a strange situation.
Horta's whole body momentum surged sharply, fighting energy surged in his body, and his right hand glowed with a strong red light.
Feeling the pressure on his hand increase sharply, in Liu Feng's dantian, the galactic cyclone suddenly accelerated its rotation speed, and powerful infuriating energy flowed along the meridians to the palm of his hand, resisting the huge pressure.
The two sides were in a stalemate.
Horta's momentum surged again, his face flushed, and it was obvious that he had used all his strength.
Liu Feng also had a solemn look on his face, and a thin layer of white energy appeared on his right hand. The cyclone in his dantian was already running at a speed exceeding the limit, causing his dantian to throb with pain.
A thick layer of turf had been scraped off the grass around the two of them by the violent momentum. Sophie also retreated more than ten steps away, looking at the two people in the field uneasily.
"Boy, what are you doing?" A loud shout came, interrupting the conversation between the two.
The two of them finished their attack and each took three quick steps back, losing their momentum.
Sophie ran over quickly and pulled Liu Feng away.Keep checking, afraid of getting hurt.
"Girl, don't worry, your little lover is very nice, I didn't hurt him at all." Hota couldn't help but teased when he saw the anxious look on Sophie's face.
Sophie, who was blushing, said coquettishly: "Uncle Huo, you..."
Liu Feng, who was behind him, stretched out his hand to pull Sophie over, clasped his fists at Huo Ta and said with a smile: "Uncle Huo, your fighting spirit is so strong, I almost couldn't hold it anymore."
"Haha, yes, you are still very good, Fei'er has good taste." Huo Ta laughed, obviously very satisfied with Liu Feng.
"You old guy, didn't you see that it was the friend that Mayfair brought? Even though he tried his best, it was really useless." An old man in a red magic robe walked out of a tent not far away and said as he walked.
"This is also my father's good friend, Huo Bao, the eighth-level great mage, and Uncle Huota's brother. He has been very good to me since I was a child." Sophie explained softly for Liu Feng.
